'''Corporate Enforcers''' were private security employed by the owners of the [[Justa starport]]&mdash;[[BlasTech Industries/Legends|BlasTech Industries]], [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka Arms]], and [[Blethern Gas Industries]]&mdash;to provide law enforcement and customs services.
